title: Localized delivery-deficit geometry: matched compact patches yield a bounded placement null
question: Do equal-volume, equal-deficit localized myocardial patches near chamber, deep tissue, or exterior materially change post-glass transit or terminal cold spots in the pinned Vitrify phantom?
method: Prescoring protocol; geometry-only compact connected voxel patches at targets 0.010 and 0.040 mL; common 0.36 mg Fe/mL local depletion compensated over remaining muscle to retain mean 1.47; released margin shell/ramp and clamped SAR; independent RK2 finite-volume integrations at 0.75 mm with 0.50-mm large-trio checks and halved time step; uniform nominal/equal-total-iron and uniform lower-mean dose controls; separate myocardial and whole-specimen diagnostics.
result: Informative bounded null: predefined placement materiality thresholds were not met. The refined 0.040-mL trio spans only 0.0399711 C in terminal myocardial minimum and 0.0210706 s in longest complete post-glass transit. Local patch cooling persists relative to uniform loading. Coarse post-glass transits are censored and spatial error/patch overlap limit generalization.

limitations: Synthetic matched-volume geometry and delivery maps; no measured coronary map or biological validation.
Large patches overlap 64.7 to 91.9 percent at 0.50 mm; geometry-only seeds shift with voxelization.
At 0.75 mm 31 large-patch voxels per placement have incomplete -123 to -35 C crossings. Complete-case transits are censored summaries, not whole-domain maxima.
Uniform cold endpoint moves by about 1.787 C across meshes; no continuum terminal-threshold certificate.
Two patch sizes have different deficit masses. No fixed-deficit-mass size effect is established.
Adiabatic boundary and clamped SAR are assumptions. No ice, mechanics, fracture, toxicity, survival or recovery conclusions.
Equal-iron spatial concepts, half-muscle maps, staged heating and rate-window ideas are prior art; novelty is restricted to these new executed localized-patch results.
No human expert review. No empirical triplicate failure inference.

scientific_assessment.limit: Patch overlap and spatial discretization limit general usefulness.
